reference_source: Machado, Oliveira & Fernandes (2009), 'A Physiologically-based Model for Simulation of Color Vision Deficiency', full-dichromacy RGB matrices
correction_method: Linear daltonization: correct = identity + error_matrix (identity - simulate). error_matrix redistributes the channel difference lost to the deficiency axis into the channels the profile can still perceive (blue for red-green axis, red/green for blue-yellow axis), following the Fidaner-Walraven-Grzywacz error-modification approach used by the daltonize algorithm.
notes: deuteranomaly and deuteranopia share the same red-green axis matrix; tritanomaly and tritanopia share the same blue-yellow axis matrix. Partial severity (anomaly) versus complete dichromacy is expressed only through the severity value (0.0-1.0) interpolated against the identity matrix by interpolate_severity, not through separate coefficient sets.
